## Key Metadata: eDNA Metabarcoding

*From field collection to taxonomy — what to capture at each step*

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="color:white; padding:12px; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:8px;"}
**Field Sampling**

- Date, Coordinates, Environmental measurements

[DwC terms:]{style="color:#E8A020; font-weight:bold;"}  
`eventID` · `eventDate` · `decimalLatitude` · `decimalLongitude`  
`samplingProtocol` · `materialSampleID` · `Env_broad_scale`
:::

::: {style="color:white; padding:12px; border-radius:8px;"}
**Biomarker / PCR**

- Primers, Target gene, PCR conditions

[DwC terms:]{style="color:#E8A020; font-weight:bold;"}  
`target_gene` · `target_subfragment` · `pcr_cond`  
`pcr_primer_forward/reverse` · `pcr_primer_name` · `pcr_primer_reference`
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="color:white; padding:12px; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:8px;"}
**DNA Extraction**

- Concentration, Extraction method, Extracted amount

[DwC terms:]{style="color:#E8A020; font-weight:bold;"}  
`samplingProtocol` · `Concentration` · `concentrationUnit`  
`ratioOfAbsorbance260_230` · `ratioOfAbsorbance260_280`
:::

::: {style="color:white; padding:12px; border-radius:8px;"}
**Sequences & Taxonomy**

- Sequencing platform, Pipeline, Reference library

[DwC terms:]{style="color:#E8A020; font-weight:bold;"}  
`seq_meth` · `lib_layout` · `associatedSequences`  
`DNA_sequence` · `otu_seq_comp_appr` · `scientificName` · `taxonID` · `otu_db`
:::
:::

::::

::: notes
At field sampling: map to eventID, decimalLatitude/Longitude, samplingProtocol, Env_broad_scale. At DNA extraction: Concentration and ratioOfAbsorbance fields. At PCR stage: target_gene, pcr_primer_forward/reverse, pcr_cond. At sequences/taxonomy: seq_meth, DNA_sequence, scientificName, taxonID, otu_db.
:::
